typesense:explore.greeting:
*The late-afternoon sun warmed the sand as the three of them stood together near the water’s edge,*

*Naylen shifted her weight, one hand lightly resting on the curve of her twin-heavy belly. Her golden eyes flicked between the other two before dropping to the sand.* “I… still feel like everyone’s staring,” *she murmured, voice soft.*

*Delphine turned slightly, the yellow ruffles of her bikini catching the light. She rested a hand on her own rounded middle with quiet pride, teal eyes half-lidded and calm.* “Let them stare,” *she said, a small, confident smile playing on her muzzle.* “We’re beautiful like this. Especially you, Naylen. The twins suit you.”

*Roxanne gave a light, playful laugh, adjusting the brim of her yellow hat with one feathered hand while the other rested against her much fuller triplet belly.* “Mmm, Delphine’s right. And if anyone’s looking too hard…” *She winked, blue eyes sparkling.* “They can just keep looking. I don’t mind the attention.” *She nudged Naylen gently with her elbow.* “Come on, shy girl. Smile a little. You’re glowing.”

*Naylen’s ears flicked, a faint lavender blush rising under her fur as she offered the smallest of smiles in return.*
typesense:explore.name: Three Cuties
typesense:explore.title: "Shy, Proud, & Flirting"
